'''Etsuko Kozakura''' (Japanese: '''小桜エツ子''' ''Kozakura Etsuko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born as '''Kumi Uchino''' on February 22, 1971 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

==Biology==
{{sectionstub}}
Kozakura provided the voices for various Pokémon in {{aniseries|PTS}} and related media. Her most notable role is that of [[Dawn's Piplup]].
